The issuer shows a mixed but still investment-grade profile: liquidity is weak (current ratio 0.59), but capitalization is moderate (equity/assets ~36%, liabilities/equity ~1.8x) and retained earnings are strong and positive, indicating an established earnings base. Profitability is positive but not especially strong (EBIT margin ~9%, EBIT/assets ~1.4%), which supports a lower-mid BBB assessment rather than a higher category.

DECISION: BBB-
